description: Mantle Network L2 telemetry from the public Mantle RPC: latest block, safe block (its batch is posted to Ethereum/EigenDA) and finalized block with numbers, times and transaction counts, the head-to-safe and head-to-finalized lags in blocks and seconds, gas price (gwei), base fee, gas used % of limit and average block time over the last 20 blocks. Treasury AUM and per-blob EigenDA statistics are not in the RPC and are not reported. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: crypto_mantle_da_eigenlayer
title: Crypto Mantle Da Eigenlayer
